name: Iona
description: One of the greater archangels of Zendikar who resisted the Eldrazi and defended Zendikar during their last awakening.

description_citations.text: "Iona". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The archangel Iona destroys the Tazeem Skyclave, ending the Makindi reign and creating Emeria.
timeline.quote: The Makindi reign ended when the archangel Iona destroyed the Tazeem Skyclave

citation.text: "Tazeem", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Iona and a few greater archangels keep their sight and fight the Eldrazi.
timeline.quote: To this day Iona fights to defend Zendikar from the Eldrazi forces that would devour it

citation.text: "The Defiance of Angels". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Apr 2010. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: The Kor Empire collapses and each Skyclave falls in a different way, from the Roil, rebellion, a sea beast, civil war, Kargan dragons, Iona, and an Eldrazi titan.
timeline.quote: over a century, the empire fractured and ultimately collapsed

citation.text: "Rise of the Skyclaves", section "The fall of the Skyclaves". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Iona keeps explorers from climbing too high, knowing Emeria the goddess was a fiction yet believing faith sustained her followers.
timeline.quote: Iona knew the truth—that the goddess Emeria was a fiction—but believed that faith in Emeria sustained her followers through the perils of Zendikar.

citation.text: "Emeria", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: With the truth revealed, Iona joins the fight to defend Zendikar from the Eldrazi, including Emrakul.
timeline.quote: Iona has joined the fight to defend Zendikar from the Eldrazi, including Emrakul

citation.text: "Emeria", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Iona defended Zendikar during the last awakening of the Eldrazi, but her power could not fend off the colorless magic of the titans.
timeline.quote: She defended Zendikar during the last awakening of the Eldrazi

citation.text: "Iona", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Iona descended from Emeria to battle the Eldrazi, leaving the Sky Ruin unguarded, and did not return after Ulamog and Kozilek were destroyed.
timeline.quote: When Iona descended from Emeria to battle the Eldrazi, she left the Sky Ruin unguarded.

citation.text: "Iona", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

relations.note: Iona no longer guards Emeria; Kasla's people do
relations.quote: Iona no longer guards this place. We do.

citation.text: Emeria's Call (Zendikar Rising Promos, 2020), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

relations.note: Kasla's shepherds guard Emeria in place of Iona
relations.quote: "Iona no longer guards this place. We do."

citation.text: Emeria's Call (Zendikar Rising, 2020), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

pages_say.description: Great archangel who still defends Zendikar from the Eldrazi; her epithet ties her to Emrakul.

citation.text: "The Defiance of Angels". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Apr 2010. Archived by the Internet Archive.

pages_say.description: A figure who left a whisper of perseverance in the Angelheart Vial.
